description.value: Okanagan Estate Wine Cellar is a specialty wine shop on Marine Drive in West Vancouver dedicated to bringing Okanagan Valley wines to Vancouver's North Shore, stocking labels from over 20 BC wineries including Mission Hill, Quails' Gate, and NK'MIP Cellars. The shop is staffed by knowledgeable wine professionals who can advise visitors across all experience levels. Cyclists passing through could pick up a bottle of BC wine to enjoy at camp or as a take-home gift.
